name: blueprint/paper-digest
description: A keyless arXiv digest: the data-adapter recipe wraps the Atom API (live-probed 200, no key), rh_text_summarise condenses abstracts, the store keeps the rolling window, notify delivers.
recipe: probe -> fixture -> parse the Atom entries (title, summary, published, authors, abs link) -> rh_text_summarise each abstract to one sentence -> store digest:<query>:<date> { entries } -> notify once -> next run diffs by id
result_kind: one digest record per query per day, diffable by id
cost_hint: one model call per abstract; the API is free
pitfalls: the API answers Atom XML, not JSON - parse entries, not a body object
redirect hop: export.arxiv.org -> arxiv.org/api (guardedFetch revalidates it)
query syntax is search_query=all:term; sort by submittedDate desc
summarise abstracts, do not re-rank the feed - say which you kept
diff by arxiv id to report only new papers
